title: Upload a system backup: the .tar the download produces, or a bare .tar.gz.enc. Body is the file itself, streamed to disk. Requires backups:import-system

Delete a system backup and its .yaml sidecar. Requires backups:delete-system
Delete the named system backups. Requires backups:delete-system

title: List deleted characters holding bases or vehicles, plus unattributed orphaned assets. See deleted-characters.md
Get player inventory items — backpack, character gear, loadout, and unique-gear schematics (emote containers excluded), each row tagged with inventory_type

Get vehicles owned by or shared with the player, including the player's access relationship. Returns at most 200 rows. Optional ?access=owner|coowner narrows the list: owner is a vehicle the player's account owns or where they hold roster rank 1; coowner is roster rank 2 on a vehicle their account does not own (default and any other value: all roster ranks; guild/public piece access is not per-player and is never listed). The filter narrows what is returned; it is not an authorization control, and players:read still gates the route

List the bases the player holds a roster rank on (one request, capped at 5,000 rows), with the player's access relationship. Optional ?access=owner|coowner narrows to rank 1 / rank 2 (default and any other value: all roster ranks; guild/public access is per-piece, so it is not listed here), and the totals follow the filter. Also accepts q, sortColumn, sortDirection

Get skill specializations. Each skillModules row carries the raw skill_points_spent (the game stores a cumulative point *cost*, not a rank) plus max_level from the catalog and the level resolved against that module's pointLadder in runtime/data/admin-skill-modules.json — read level for the rank
